title: String matchAll
Array sort Is Lexicographic by Default
code:
const nums = [10, 9, 2, 100, 21];
console.log(nums.sort());

bugs.explanation: Array `sort()` converts elements to strings and compares them lexicographically by default. So `[10, 9, 2, 100, 21].sort()` gives `[10, 100, 2, 21, 9]`. Provide a numeric comparator `(a, b) => a - b` for correct numeric sorting.
